concerns.text: The plan cites the dataset `FatimaSohailll/PPM-Image-Dataset-for-KLT-Feature-Tracking` as the source of “Microbiome ASV” data. This HuggingFace repository contains an image dataset for KLT feature tracking, not a 16S rRNA ASV table from the Parkinson’s Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI). Using this dataset would provide irrelevant data and cannot answer the research question about gut microbiome composition.

The clinical metadata is sourced from `mcbuehler/pp_mixed_v0`, which is not the verified PPMI clinical dataset required for longitudinal motor scores (UPDRS III or MDS_UPDRS_total). This dataset may lack the necessary outcome variables, violating FR‑004 and preventing the pipeline from computing the required slopes.
